quests.name: Overseas Delivery
quests.text: Deliver Fizzgrimble's Mysterious Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

quests.name: Wastewander Justice
quests.text: Take down 10 Wastewander Bandits and Thieves east of Gadgetzan, then report back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle.

quests.name: More Wastewander Justice
quests.text: Take down 10 Wastewander Shadow Mages, 8 Wastewander Rogues, and 6 Wastewander Assassins for Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Water Pouch Bounty
quests.text: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Spigot Operator Luglunket in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Screecher Spirits
quests.text: Capture the spirits of 3 screechers in Feralas, then return to Yeh'kinya in Steamwheedle Port.

quests.name: Clamlette Surprise
quests.text: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:  12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird.  10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally!  20 pieces of Alterac Swiss. Get thee to a cheesery!  Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.

quests.name: A Good Head On Your Shoulders
quests.text: Bring two Mithril Coifs and one Ornate Mithril Shoulder to Trenton Lighthammer.

quests.name: The World At Your Feet
quests.text: Bring two Heavy Mithril Boots and one Ornate Mithril Pants to Trenton Lighthammer.

quests.name: The Mithril Kid
quests.text: Bring two Heavy Mithril Breastplates and one Ornate Mithril Gloves to Trenton Lighthammer.

quests.name: Tran'rek
quests.text: Speak with Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Scarab Shells
quests.text: Bring 5 Uncracked Scarab Shells to Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Stoley's Debt
quests.text: Speak with Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.

quests.name: Stoley's Shipment
quests.text: Bring Stoley's Shipment to Stoley in Steamwheedle Port.

quests.name: Deliver to MacKinley
quests.text: Bring Stoley's Bottle to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.

quests.name: WANTED: Andre Firebeard
quests.text: Bring Andre's Head to Security Chief Bilgewhizzle in Steamwheedle Port.

quests.name: Ship Schedules
quests.text: Report the Ship Schedules to an authority in Steamwheedle Port.

quests.name: Cuergo's Gold
quests.text: Find Cuergo's gold!

quests.name: The Spider God
quests.text: Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.

quests.name: Troll Temper
quests.text: Bring 20 Vials of Troll Temper to Trenton Lighthammer in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Pirate Hats Ahoy!
quests.text: Haughty Modiste wants you to collect 20 Southsea Pirate Hats and return them to her at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

quests.name: Southsea Shakedown
quests.text: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to kill 10 Southsea Pirates, 10 Southsea Freebooters, 10 Southsea Dock Workers and 10 Southsea Swashbucklers.

quests.name: Gritty Business
quests.text: Quinn wants you to recover 7 pieces of Desert Debris and return to her in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Gnomish Garbage
quests.text: Jhordy Lapforge wants you to return to him after you have dumped the Crate of Radioactive Refuse in the desert of Tanaris a safe distance away from Gadgetzan and other trash.

quests.name: Into the Field
quests.text: Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan about getting a power source for the testing kit.

quests.name: Slake That Thirst
quests.text: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Tanaris Field Sampling
quests.text: Acquire acceptable samples for 8 basilisks, 8 hyenas, and 8 scorpions. Bring the testing kit back to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan before the power source runs out.

quests.name: Another Power Source?
quests.text: Bring 10 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan in exchange for another power source.

quests.name: Gadgetzan Water Survey
quests.text: Use the untapped dowsing widget near the pool of water by Sandsorrow Watch. Once you have collected the sample, return the tapped dowsing widget to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: WANTED: Caliph Scorpidsting
quests.text: Bring the head of Caliph Scorpidsting to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Tiara of the Deep
quests.text: Bring the Tiara of the Deep to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

quests.name: Tabetha's Task
quests.text: Speak with Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

quests.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
quests.text: If you agree to become a Goblin Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Show Your Work
quests.text: Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Noxious Lair Investigation
quests.text: Bring five Centipaar insect parts from the Noxious Lair to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Divino-matic Rod
quests.text: Bring the Divino-matic Rod to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Nekrum's Medallion
quests.text: Bring Nekrum's Medallion to Thadius Grimshade in the Blasted Lands.

quests.name: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru
quests.text: Bring the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

quests.name: Dunemaul Dues
quests.text: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to recover a particularly shiny bangle bracelet lost near the Dunemaul ogre compound.

quests.name: Handle With Care
quests.text: Bring the Carefully-packed Crate to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

quests.name: The Scrimshank Redemption
quests.text: Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Rise of the Silithid
quests.text: Take the report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Insect Part Analysis
quests.text: Check in Gadgetzan for Alchemist Pestlezugg and his analysis of the insect parts.

quests.name: Insect Part Analysis
quests.text: Deliver the report to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan. Be sure he gives you a copy of the report, as Alchemist Pestlezugg has requested.

quests.name: Find OOX-17/TN!
quests.text: Bring the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot.

quests.name: Rescue OOX-17/TN!
quests.text: Escort OOX-17/TN to Steamwheedle Port, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Gahz'ridian
quests.text: Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.

quests.name: Rise of the Silithid
quests.text: Take the Insect Analysis Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

quests.name: The Thirsty Goblin
quests.text: Collect a Laden Dew Gland and bring it to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: In Good Taste
quests.text: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak with Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Sprinkle's Secret Ingredient
quests.text: Sprinkle in Gadgetzan wants you to collect a Violet Tragan and return it to her.

quests.name: Delivery for Marin
quests.text: Sprinkle wants to you take the Violet Powder to Marin Noggenfogger in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Noggenfogger Elixir
quests.text: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak to him again after he creates his elixir.

quests.name: The Dunemaul Compound
quests.text: Andi Lynn in Gadgetzan wants you to destroy the Dunemaul Compound by killing 10 Dunemaul Brutes, 10 Dunemaul Enforcers, and Gor'marok the Ravager.

quests.name: Tooga's Quest
quests.text: Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.

quests.name: Gahz'rilla
quests.text: Bring Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.

quests.name: Did You Lose This?
quests.text: Wait for Trenton to finish his work.

quests.name: The Stone Watcher
quests.text: Learn the purpose of the Stone Watcher of Norgannon, and then interact with the Uldum Pedestal in the Tanaris desert.

quests.name: Thistleshrub Valley
quests.text: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.

quests.name: The Stone Circle
quests.text: Retrieve the Stone Circle from Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop in Ratchet.

quests.name: Into the Depths
quests.text: Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in Swamp of Sorrows.

quests.name: Secret of the Circle
quests.text: Travel into the Sunken Temple and discover the secret hidden in the circle of statues.

quests.name: The God Hakkar
quests.text: Bring the Filled Egg of Hakkar to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

quests.name: Bungle in the Jungle
quests.text: Bring a Gorishi Scent Gland and 5 Un'Goro Soil samples to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Super Sticky
quests.text: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Pawn Captures Queen
quests.text: Defeat the Gorishi Hive Queen once she is summoned.  Bring the Gorishi Queen's Brain to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Calm Before the Storm
quests.text: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

quests.name: Calm Before the Storm
quests.text: Bring Pestlezugg's Un'Goro Report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Fire Plume Forged
quests.text: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.  Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Alchemist Arbington at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: Fire Plume Forged
quests.text: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.  Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

quests.name: The Hand of Rastakhan
quests.text: Speak with Molthor in Stranglethorn.

quests.name: The Ectoplasmic Distiller
quests.text: Return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan with 1 Delicate Arcanite Converter, 4 Greater Eternal Essence, 10 Stonescale Oil, 25 Volcanic Ash and 40 gold.

quests.name: A Supernatural Device
quests.text: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

quests.name: A Supernatural Device
quests.text: Take the Sealed Venom Container to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Hunting for Ectoplasm
quests.text: Use the Ectoplasmic Distiller near incorporeal undead to collect 12 Scorched Ectoplasms in Silithus, 12 Frozen Ectoplasms in Winterspring and 12 Stable Ectoplasms in the Eastern Plaguelands. Bring them along with the Ectoplasmic Distiller back to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: A Portable Power Source
quests.text: Find Magma Lord Bokk in the Burning Steppes, obtain his Magma Core and bring it to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: A Shifty Merchant
quests.text: Search for an imp inside a cave at the entrance of Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, purchase a Fel Elemental Rod and return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Stewvul, Ex-B.F.F.
quests.text: Narain Soothfancy wants you to find his ex-best friend forever (BFF), Stewvul, and take back the scrying goggles that Stewvul stole from him.

quests.name: Never Ask Me About My Business
quests.text: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to speak with Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: The Isle of Dread!
quests.text: Recover Lakmaeran's Carcass and 20 Chimaerok Tenderloins for Dirge Quikcleave in Tanaris.

quests.name: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops
quests.text: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan wants you to bring him 20 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 20 Deeprock Salt.

quests.name: Return to Narain
quests.text: Deliver the 500 Pound Chicken to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Draconic for Dummies
quests.text: Find Narain Soothfancy's book, buried on an island in the South Seas.

quests.name: rAnS0m
quests.text: Return the Ransom Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Love Song for Narain
quests.text: Take Meridith's Love Letter to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: Decoy!
quests.text: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to travel to Winterspring and place the Bag of Gold at the drop off point documented by the booknappers.

objectives.text: Who Does Number Two Work For?

quests.name: The Only Prescription
quests.text: Recover the 8 lost chapters of Draconic for Dummies and combine them with the Magical Book Binding and return the completed book of Draconic for Dummies: Volume II to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Good News and The Bad News
quests.text: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to bring him 20 Arcanite Bars, 10 Elementium Ore, 10 Azerothian Diamonds, and 10 Blue Sapphires.

quests.name: The Changing of Paths - Protector No More
The Changing of Paths - Invoker No More
The Changing of Paths - Conqueror No More
Frame of Atiesh
quests.text: Find someone that will help you in recovering the last two pieces of the staff and ridding it of evil.

quests.name: Atiesh, the Befouled Greatstaff
quests.text: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants the Staff Head of Atiesh and the Base of Atiesh.

quests.name: Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian
quests.text: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.

quests.text: Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.
